note: Menu v2 keeps arms A0-A3 verbatim from the frozen four-arm contract and adds two arms that separate repair depth from repair content: a three-decision restoration and a relocation message.

A1.name: WARNING
A1.text: Re-check the goal, the latest observation, and your previous action. Continue only after correcting any inconsistency you notice.

A2.name: REPLAN
A2.text: Construct a fresh, concise plan from the current goal and observable state. Then execute that plan.

A3.name: ROLLBACK_REPLAN
A3.text: The previous attempted action has been reverted. Construct a fresh, concise plan from the current goal and restored observable state. Then execute that plan.
A3.environment_operation: Restore environment and dialogue to before the most recent reversible action.

A4.name: DEEP_ROLLBACK_REPLAN
A4.text: Your three most recent decisions have been reverted and the environment restored to the state before them. Construct a fresh, concise plan from the current goal and restored observable state. Then execute that plan.
A4.environment_operation: Restore environment and dialogue to three decisions before the checkpoint, clamped at the episode start; the suffix budget is reduced by the number of reverted decisions so the total decision budget is unchanged.

A5.name: LOCATE
A5.text: Before acting again, name the objects this task still requires and the places you have not yet inspected. Then inspect the most promising place.

injection_protocol.position: The overseer text is appended to the observable transcript as an [OVERSEER] entry immediately before the agent's next action decision at the checkpoint step.
injection_protocol.persistence: The overseer entry remains in the transcript for the remainder of the episode.
